item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 28/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier over the region. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Friday. Temperatures will drop slightly and the weather will be mainly fine over the region in the latter part of this week. With the monsoon moderating slightly early next week, daytime temperatures will rise over Guangdong.
